reason: Rewrites the MediaField drag/drop UI (swapping vue-draggable for SortableJS multiDrag, changing the component to v-model, custom reorder logic, and template/markup changes) which affects a widely-used content-editing widget across all tenants, so subtle bugs in reordering/selection or the min.js bundle could break media field editing broadly, though it's isolated to one module's front-end.
